answer: Make each identity pay twice: a one-time admission proof-of-work plus a live vouch-bond of k countersignatures from established peers, your anchors. An anchor stakes reputation with every vouch, so a botnet pays compute per head and must still corrupt k independent anchors to earn; one crooked anchor is slashed and its whole clique orphaned. Honest standing grows slowly, reef-like, and only reaches the zenith after many answered epochs, so a fresh sybil swarm starts at zero weight and bleeds cost before first payout.
